description: The console has no way for a human to create a share link, list existing links, or revoke one. Row actions are only Download, Versions, Trash. Share links are the product's main way to send a file to a person without an account, and the only route is asking an agent.
expected: A Share action on each file row (expiry choice, copy link), plus a list of active links with Revoke, matching the recipient page that already exists.
actual: Row actions Download / Versions / Trash; Agents, API keys and Activity pages contain no share UI (step-2, step-3, step-4, step-5 screenshots).
suggested_fix: Add a Share row action: the browser already holds the drive key, so it can create the share the same way the CLI does. Add a Shares list (path, expiry, Revoke). Minimum: a hint under the file table 'To share a link, ask your agent: agent-drive share <path>'.

description: Trash has no confirmation and no warning that active share links for the file stop working. I trashed a file with a live link; the owner got only 'Moved ... to Trash' and the recipient then saw 'Shared file unavailable'.
expected: The notice (or a confirm) mentions that N active share links will stop working; Restore revives them.
actual: Notice 'Moved /work/walkerc/b.txt to Trash. Restore it from the Trash tab.' (step-6 screenshot). The Trash action sits next to Versions as a low-emphasis link and is easy to hit.
suggested_fix: Include the live-share count in the trash notice; keep one-click trash (it is restorable) but make the notice an Undo.

criterion: Information stated once / signal vs noise
description: The audit log on Activity & deletion is filled with the console's own read calls (console.audit.list, drives.list, console.usage.read, 'Console user', HTTP 200) so each page view adds rows and real agent activity is buried. Action names are raw internal codes.
expected: Audit shows security-relevant events (writes, shares, key and grant changes, revocations); reads by the console are hidden or filterable.
actual: Top 10 rows are all reads generated by my own navigation (step-5-activity.png).
suggested_fix: Filter console.* read actions out of the default view or add an action filter; map codes to plain labels.

description: 'Activity & deletion' leaves the console shell: it opens /console/settings with a different header (Billing, Back to files) and no sidebar, while Files/Agents/API keys/Usage/Trash switch in place. Billing & limits does the same. The URL says 'settings' but the label says 'Activity & deletion'.
expected: Consistent navigation chrome, or a visual cue that these two items are separate pages.
suggested_fix: Render settings and billing inside the console layout.

description: On Files, key status appears twice: the banner 'Key backed up 11/6/2026 (file)' and the chip 'KEY REQUIRED FOR DOWNLOADS' / 'KEY LOADED'. The banner reads as relevant to the current drive but is account-level text that stays even when the key is not loaded.
actual: Banner plus chip in the same view.
suggested_fix: Merge the two; show the backup banner only when a backup is missing.
